# Library Guides at University of Portland

> Comprehensive library research guides, tutorials, and academic support resources for University of Portland students and faculty.

The University of Portland Library Guides portal provides organized access to subject-specific and course-specific research guides, citation resources, account tutorials, and library collections. The site serves as the primary hub for students to discover research support, learn information literacy skills, and access library services.

## Key Topics

- Library Guides
- Research Resources
- UP Network Account
- UP Library Search
- Citation Styles
- Academic Support
- Information Literacy
- Course Guides
- Subject Guides
- Library Catalog
- Getting Started
- Library Tutorials
- University of Portland
- Guide Directory
- Library Portal

## Core Portal & Navigation

- [Library Guides Homepage](https://libguides.up.edu): Homepage for University of Portland Library Guides portal
- [Library Guides Home](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/home): Home page for University of Portland library services and guides
- [Library Guides Directory](https://libguides.up.edu/guides): Main guides directory for University of Portland library tutorials

## Research & Subject Guides

- [Subject Guides](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/subject): Subject-specific research guides and tutorials for academic research
- [Course Guides](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/courses): Course-specific research guides for University of Portland students
- [Getting Started](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/start): Getting started guide for University of Portland library resources
- [Featured Collections](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/featured): Featured library collections and curated research resources
- [General Interest Guides](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/general): General interest library guides for University of Portland community

## Citation & Academic Writing

- [Citing Sources](https://libguides.up.edu/cite): Citation style guide for academic writing and source documentation

## Tutorials & Account Access

- [UP Account Tutorials](https://libguides.up.edu/tutorials): Tutorials for UP Network Account access and library search tools
- [Library System Tutorials](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/tutorials): Account and library system tutorials for University of Portland users

## Support & Help

- [More Help](https://libguides.up.edu/guides/help): Help resources and contact information for University of Portland library
